title: Certificate Dashboard
intro: Issue certificates with QR codes anyone can check.

secure.title: Securing the verification page
secure.text: Copying certificates into the locked verification store: {{done}} of {{total}}. Keep this page open.
secure.doneTitle: The participant list is now protected
secure.doneText: {{count}} certificates can be verified by their own code, but the full list can no longer be pulled from outside.
secure.failedText: Reload the page to continue. Existing QR codes keep working.

loadFailed: Certificates could not be loaded. Check your connection and reload the page.

empty.title: No certificates yet
empty.text: Issue one certificate, or many at once from an Excel list.

fields.name: Name (Latin script)
fields.eventDateHint: Optional. Shown on the verification page.
fields.signersDefault: Leave empty to use the default signers ({{names}})
fields.bilingualHint: Fill in one or both. Arabic pages show the Arabic text; other languages show the Latin text.
fields.langHint: The verification page opens in this language. The person scanning can still switch.

editor.sameCode: The code {{code}} stays the same, so printed certificates stay valid.

errors.noName: Enter the participant's name (Latin or Arabic).
errors.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.sameAccount: Choose the same Google account you are signed in with.

notices.savedText: The verification page for {{name}} is updated.

delete.title: Delete certificate?
delete.text: The certificate for {{name}} will be deleted permanently. Google will ask you to confirm your account once more.
delete.revokeHint: Only want to mark it invalid? Use Revoke — the verification page will say so clearly.

revoke.title: Revoke certificate
revoke.text: The verification page for {{name}} will say this certificate was revoked. You can make it valid again at any time.
revoke.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Issued to the wrong person
revoke.reasonHint: Shown to anyone who scans the code.

qr.hint: Print-ready, with the MTI logo in the middle.

bulk.title: Issue many certificates
bulk.excelHint: Choose an Excel file (.xlsx) with the participants' names.
bulk.excelFailed: The file could not be read. Make sure it is .xlsx (Excel), not .xls or .csv.
bulk.pasteHint: One name per line. For both scripts, separate with a Tab: Latin name, then Arabic name (copying two columns from Google Sheets does this).
bulk.skipped: {{count}} names already have a certificate with this description and are skipped.
bulk.nothing: There are no new names to issue.
bulk.doneText: Download all QR codes at once, and the list of names + codes for a mail merge in Canva or Word.

backup.exportText: A JSON copy of {{count}} certificates to keep somewhere safe.
backup.importText: Codes that already exist are skipped, so it is safe to run more than once.
backup.importedText: {{count}} certificates restored, {{skipped}} skipped because they already exist.
backup.badFile: This file is not a certificate backup.
backup.note: Restored certificates keep their original codes, so printed QR codes stay valid.

signers.intro: Signatures and stamps appear on the page people see when they scan a certificate's QR code.
signers.fullNamePlaceholder: e.g. Dr. Ahmad Fauzi, Lc., M.A.
signers.signatureHint: Photo or scan of the signature
signers.notImage: Choose an image file (PNG, JPG, WEBP).
signers.badImage: The image could not be read.
signers.removeWhiteHint: Makes scanned paper transparent so the ink sits cleanly on the page.
signers.defaultHint: Shown automatically on certificates that don't pick specific signers (including older ones).
signers.activeHint: Inactive signers are hidden from every certificate.
signers.orderHint: Order here = order on the verification page
signers.empty: No signers yet. Until there are, the verification page shows the standard stamp.
signers.deleteText: will no longer appear on any certificate. To keep them for later, hide them instead.
signers.missingImage: Upload at least a signature or a stamp.

documents.dropTitle: Drop a Word file to issue a certificate with it
documents.dropText: Only .docx. Fill in the certificate details as usual; on save the QR is added at the bottom of the last page and the file downloads back. The file itself is not uploaded.
documents.empty: No Word files yet. Drop one above, or use the Word button on any certificate.

checkResult.file: Same file — exactly as it was stamped
checkResult.text: Same document — the text matches (layout may have changed in Word)
checkResult.none: Not found — this file was not stamped here, or its text was changed

documents.deleteText: “{{title}}” and its QR stop working straight away. This cannot be undone.
documents.noSnapshot: No picture was saved for this document.

errors.notDocx: Only Word .docx files can be stamped
errors.alreadyStamped: This file already has an MTI QR
errors.unreadable: This Word file could not be read
errors.alreadyStampedFor: It carries the QR of certificate {{code}}. Use the Word button on that certificate instead.

documents.newHint: This file gets the new certificate's QR when you save, then downloads back to you.
documents.attach: Stamp a Word file with this QR
documents.replace: Stamp another Word file with this QR
